text:
user: Busy season starts this week. I'm an audit senior at a Big Four firm, so goodbye weekends until March.
assistant: That's a long stretch. Anything you want to protect?

user: Sleep, mainly.
assistant: Then set a hard stop time on most nights.

user: My pottery class in Jalan Besar is on Sundays at 10. This week we threw cylinders and mine collapsed three times.
assistant: Everyone's first cylinders collapse. Usually it's too much water or uneven pressure.

user: I was diagnosed with generalised anxiety disorder last year, and busy season really sets it off. Can you help me plan a realistic week?
assistant: Of course. With GAD, short breaks and a fixed sleep time help. Try a hard stop at 10pm, a 10-minute walk after lunch, and one free evening.

user: The walk I can do. The 10pm stop, my manager will laugh.
assistant: Then aim for 11pm and protect it on most nights.

user: My brother Jun Hao is getting married in Perth in September! His fiancée is Australian.
assistant: Congratulations to him. Spring in Perth is lovely in September.

user: Doing overnight oats for meal prep. Any flavour combos that aren't boring?
assistant: Try peanut butter and banana, matcha with white sesame, or mango with coconut yoghurt.

user: The matcha one sounds good.
assistant: Add a little honey, matcha can be bitter.

user: Session with Dr Lim today, my psychologist. I see her every two weeks. We worked on catching my catastrophising before it spirals.
assistant: That sounds useful. Did she give you anything to practise?

user: Writing down the worst case, then the most likely case.
assistant: Simple and effective.

user: Moving to a rental in Bishan with my friend Clara at the end of the month. Any checklist?
assistant: Read the tenancy agreement carefully, photograph the flat at handover, and set up utilities in advance.

user: Booking flights to Perth for Jun Hao's wedding. Direct, or via KL to save money?
assistant: Direct is only about five hours. Worth it unless the saving is big.

user: It saves $180.
assistant: Your call, but the layover adds about four hours.

user: Presenting to the partners tomorrow. I'll do my box breathing in the loo beforehand like always.
assistant: Good routine. In for four, hold four, out for four, hold four. You've got this.

user: Glazed my first set of four bowls in celadon at pottery! One cracked in the kiln but three survived.
assistant: Three out of four is a good kiln rate for a beginner.

user: Looking after my neighbour's corgi Biscuit this weekend. He eats everything.
assistant: Keep shoes and cables out of reach and he'll be fine.

user: He already ate a sock.
assistant: Watch him for vomiting. If he seems unwell, call a vet.

user: Thinking of leaving external audit for an internal audit role at a bank. Better hours, slightly less pay.
assistant: A common move after a few busy seasons. What matters more to you right now?

user: Honestly, my weekends.
assistant: Then internal audit makes sense.

user: Haidilao with Clara tonight to celebrate our first months in the flat. We always get the tomato soup base.
assistant: Good choice. Order the noodle dance for the show.
